ports.title: Ports
ports.description: Limit to these ports. Leave empty for all six ports and the total.

flows.title: Flows
flows.description: Limit to total, export and/or import. Leave empty for all.

includeArchive.title: Include recent past weeks
includeArchive.description: Also read MLIT's archive file with the previous weeks (about two months). Off = only the latest week.

onlyNew.title: Monitoring mode: new and revised rows only
onlyNew.description: Output only weeks not returned before (changeType = new) and rows whose published values changed (changeType = revision). Schedule weekly.
